t: WD-40 specialist high performance silicone lubricant that prevents parts from sticking. With integral smart straw system for ease of use. Use on wood, metal, rubber and plastic. Can be used on high pressure equipment. Withstands temperatures of -35°C to 200°C. Formulated for improved performance on high pressure equipment such as hydraulics, valves and fittings in industry or the workplace. Flip straw down for spray or up for a precise, narrow spray. 360° valve allows for upright or upside-down application.
